newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania and Hungary will support each other for a simultaneous early admission to NATO, said Victor Orban, president of the Hungarian parliament's commission for European integration.
* The self-proclaimed gypsy king Ioan Cioaba, 62, died on Sunday night of a heart attack in a Bucharest hospital. His body was taken to his home-town Sibiu for funerals.
